chunks.text: Been thinking about a quick hop from Beijing over to Shanghai sometime soon, just to see if I can make a work thing happen.
And separately, I might swing through Wuhan too, so I’ve got that city on my mind for where I’d even stay.
If I actually end up doing the Shanghai leg, I keep circling that China Eastern option — flight MU5678 — though I’m still kind of undecided.
For the Wuhan part, I was eyeballing Shangri-La Wuhan, checking in on 2026-03-03 for 4 nights, but it really depends how the schedule shakes out.
If it comes together, the flight date I had in mind was 2026-03-25 and it’d be under Tang Xue, and the hotel guest name would be Xu Jing… not sure if I’ll actually do this.
